indexes.name: flyway_schema_history_pk

indexes.name: flyway_schema_history_s_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX flyway_schema_history_s_idx ON public.flyway_schema_history USING btree (success)

indexes.name: notification_log_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notification_log_pkey ON public.notification_log USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_notification_log_notification_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_notification_log_notification_id ON public.notification_log USING btree (notification_id)

indexes.name: idx_notification_log_recipient
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_notification_log_recipient ON public.notification_log USING btree (recipient)

indexes.name: idx_notification_log_status_sent_at
